title: Almost every half-space slice of a positive multiple of an oriented plane with the integer slice property is an integer multiplicity multiple of the boundary plane
statement: (SL) is the exact frozen statement of the DAG theorem cmc_slice_mass_bounds (a hypothesis of the selected parent cbr_ci_plane_multiplicity_nat, copied verbatim as the first hypothesis of the Lean statement): for P, k ∈ ℕ, an open U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), Borel measures μ, μ′ finite on compact subsets of U, fields ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_{k+1}, ξ′ : ℝ^P → Λ_k that are μ- resp. μ′-a.e. strongly measurable with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| μ-a.e. and |ξ′(x)(α)| ≤ |α| μ′-a.e., T(ω) = ∫ξ(x)(ω(x))dμ(x) and ∂T(η) = ∫ξ′(x)(η(x))dμ′(x) for all test forms, and an L-Lipschitz f : ℝ^P → ℝ, there are currents A_t ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), B_t ∈ 𝒟_k(U) (t ∈ ℝ) with A_t(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ(x)(ω(x))dμ(x), B_t(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ′(x)(η(x))dμ′(x), ∂A_t = B_t on forms supported off {f = t}, M_W(∂A_t − B_t) ≤ L·liminf_{h↓0}h⁻¹μ(W ∩ {t−h < f < t}) and ∫_a^b M_W(∂A_t − B_t)dt ≤ Lμ(W ∩ {a < f < b}) for open W. Notation: ℝ^P = Euclid P, Hᵐ = μHE[m] (Mathlib's normalised Euclidean Hausdorff measure; μHE[0] = μH[0] is counting measure), |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α for a covector α, Λ_k = MultiVector P k (continuous linear functionals on k-covectors), a test k-form is an element of TestFormOn univ k, dφ = exteriorDerivative φ, ∂T(η) = T(dη). An admissible representation (μ, ξ) of a current X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) is a Borel measure μ finite on compact sets with a μ-a.e. strongly measurable ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_k, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| μ-a.e., and X(ω) = ∫ξ(x)(ω(x))dμ(x) for every test form. ISP (integer slice property) of Y ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P): for all admissible representations (μ, ξ) of Y and (μ′, ξ′) of ∂Y and every Lipschitz f : ℝ^P → ℝ, for L¹-a.e. t, all A ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P), B ∈ 𝒟_d(ℝ^P) with A(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ(ω)dμ and B(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ′(η)dμ′ for all test forms have ∂A − B integer multiplicity. Assume (SL). Let P, d ∈ ℕ, n := d+1, v = (v_0, …, v_d) orthonormal in ℝ^P, V₀ := span(v), θ₀ > 0 and C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with C(ω) = θ₀∫_{V₀}ω(y)(v_0, …, v_d)dHⁿ(y) for every test n-form ω, and suppose C has ISP. Then for L¹-almost every t ∈ ℝ there is an integer multiplicity current Z ∈ 𝒟_d(ℝ^P) with Z(φ) = θ₀∫_{L_t}φ(y)(v_1, …, v_d)dH^d(y) for every test d-form φ, where L_t := {y ∈ ℝ^P : y − t v_0 ∈ span(v_1, …, v_d)} and (v_1, …, v_d) = Fin.tail v.
